release_notes:
1. Event Catalog Clean-up: Completely removed page_view and select_item from the Back Office event catalog and advertising platform matrix.
2. Advertising Event Routing Persistence: Resolved duplicate form input collisions between Matrix View and Cards View by implementing real-time two-way synchronization and submit-time input deduplication, guaranteeing that event toggles persist accurately across all platforms.
3. Platform Master Controls: Added dedicated platform master toggle switches directly to Matrix View column headers for Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Pinterest, and Microsoft Ads.
4. Form Validation Fix: Removed unnecessary required attribute from GTM Container ID input to prevent silent browser blocking across tab changes.
